$comment: The services whose keys scenes may use (docs/service-keys.md). Data only: never compiled into a frame. Add a vendor with one entry here and run python3 frameos/tools/generate_services.py. An id is a settings namespace apps name in their config.json `settings` list; a field is secret unless it says "secret": false. `hosts` (and `hostsFrom`, a field holding a URL) are where frameos.secret placeholders may be sent.
